LanguageData.AM_Assumptions: Assumptions: current diets, policies and access persist. Feeding order is staged: humans first eat food animals cannot use, then shared food; animals eat today's pen growth first, then plants already standing in the pen, then stored feed. Seasonal pen growth uses vanilla quadrum estimates, set to zero at modeled freezing temperature; unused daily growth is not carried over and standing plants are not replenished. Forecast allocation can differ from game AI. No automatic feeding or slaughter.
LanguageData.AM_Invalidation: Recalculate after pen/door/area or food policy changes, births/deaths, migration or stock changes. Raids, weather anomalies, handler feeding of animals and future maturation are not modeled. Grazers outside pens are excluded from the forecast. Estimates remain uncertain, especially when partial.
LanguageData.AM_Stale: Settings changed or snapshot absent: recalculate.
LanguageData.AM_Failed: Calculation failed; any earlier snapshot is stale and must not be used as a current forecast.
LanguageData.AM_Scan: Snapshot tick {0}; calculation {1} ms / {2} access checks (not a TPS measurement)
LanguageData.AM_NoPopulationBaseline: Birth/death scenario omitted: no existing species population to extrapolate.
LanguageData.AM_Spoilage: Modeled stock nutrition lost to spoilage: {0}
LanguageData.AM_NutritionAssumptions: Demand uses each pawn's fed consumption rate, not the slower rate shown while hungry. Stocks use the minimum eater-specific nutrition among verified consumers. Prisoners and downed colonists are assumed to be served from food a free colonist can reach; babies are assumed breastfed while a lactating colonist is present. Spoilage uses seasonal outdoor temperature or maintained current room temperature; food expiring during a day is conservatively excluded for that day. Temperature control failure, processing and future deliveries invalidate the projection.

LanguageData.AM_AlertExplanation: A complete forecast predicts that colony animals will run short of feed within the warning threshold. This is a conditional estimate based on the stated assumptions, not a certainty.
LanguageData.AM_ShowAlert: Show an alert when a feed shortage is predicted
LanguageData.AM_NoAnchor: No verified hay/kibble stack. Place permitted feed in an accessible storage area, then refresh. No access is assumed.
LanguageData.AM_PlanConditions: Scenario: existing diets, shared human food, verified destination, seasonal growth and spoilage. Assumes all replacement feed is available at the start; this is not a delivery guarantee.
LanguageData.AM_NoSolution: This feed/destination cannot cover every diet within the calculation limit. Choose another destination or feed.
LanguageData.AM_Provisional: Provisional: weather, population, spoilage or incomplete observations prevent automatic actions.
LanguageData.AM_ProductionConditions: Production is checked separately: an estimate is not proof of ingredients, a safe workbench or timely completion.
LanguageData.AM_HayConditions: Hay growing: choose existing fertile growing zones and a viable growing season. Winter/cold growth and future weather cannot establish a guaranteed area or harvest date. No zones are created automatically.
LanguageData.AM_ProductionBlocked: Production blocked: a complete reliable forecast, safe vanilla recipe/bench, accessible permitted ingredients, storage and a proven net nutrition benefit are required.
LanguageData.AM_DuplicateBill: An existing bill already uses this recipe. It will not be changed or duplicated.
LanguageData.AM_HayArea: Illustrative full harvest: {0} cells; base growth {1} days. Does not account for local growing hours, fertility, losses or cold; not a guaranteed field size.
LanguageData.AM_ProductionPreview: Produce up to {0} items at {1}. Materials below are consumed; full reserve coverage and completion time are not guaranteed. The batch count is fixed; production progress or edits release automatic ownership.
LanguageData.AM_AllowTarget: Permit automatic actions for this bench and destination
LanguageData.AM_RevokeTarget: Revoke automatic permission for this bench/destination
LanguageData.AM_ProductionConfirm: Create a managed instruction for up to {0} items at {1}? It consumes the previewed ingredients and reserves this destination. No manual bills are changed. This is a finite batch order; no automatic replenishment is attached.
LanguageData.AM_ActionChanged: Conditions changed or the action limit/cooldown blocked execution. Refresh the preview.
LanguageData.AM_CapacityConditions: Capacity scenario: other species and humans stay fixed, shared food counted once. Species estimates are alternatives, not additive. Future births and aging are uncertain; population scenarios use proportional demand.
LanguageData.AM_CapacityUnsolved: Reducing this species alone cannot eliminate the other animals’ shortage.
LanguageData.AM_CapacityResult: Current {0}; scenario capacity {1} for {2} days; possible excess {3}.
LanguageData.AM_CapacityBound: Calculation cap reached (400); no higher capacity is asserted.
LanguageData.AM_AllowSlaughter: Allow confirmed auto-slaughter configuration previews (may lead to irreversible slaughter)
LanguageData.AM_SlaughterConfirm: Change {0} total limit from {1} to {2}? Vanilla may then slaughter animals irreversibly. Pregnant/bonded animals will be protected; other sex/age limits remain. This requires confirmation even in Auto mode.
